title: Omarchy Flish hint template
description: One parameterized Socratic hint, written and approved by a person. Never generated at runtime.

id.description: Stable, human-readable. Telemetry references it, so it is never reused for different copy.

match.description: All present conditions must hold. An absent condition is not checked.

stderr.description: Regex over the authentic error line.

requires.description: VFS state decorators. These are what separate two failures that print the same error but teach different lessons.

target_near_sibling.description: A sibling name is within edit distance 2 of what was typed. The typo case, and the one most worth separating from a plain miss.

target_in_parent.description: The name that was not found here exists one level up. The wrong-room case.

cwd_is_root.description: The child is at the top of the tree, so there is no further up to go.

target_is_empty_dir.description: The target is a directory with nothing in it.

argv_count.description: Exact argument count. Separates 'you gave none' from 'you gave three', which are different lessons at the same status.

near_sibling_is_dir.description: The near-miss sibling is a directory rather than a file. Splits the typo lesson by type: almost-typing a folder name means the next step is to walk into it, not to fix the spelling and retry the same command.

min_strike.description: Consecutive same-signature failures before this may fire. The engine fires the most specific matching template whose min_strike is met, so a higher value is how a second, blunter hint is held back until the first has not worked.

body.description: Socratic. Must ask, never instruct. Must NOT contain a runnable command line -- the child types the answer, the tutor does not supply it. Supports {{target}}.

ttl_ms.description: Auto-dismiss delay. 0 means stay until dismissed.
